name: Shorterm – The Simple & Fast URL Shortener for WordPress
author: dimitrisevis

sections.description:
Looking for a URL shortener that just works?

Shorterm is built for simplicity and efficiency. It helps you manage your links effortlessly, keeps your data private, and protects your SEO.

It is the perfect solution for creating clean URLs using your own domain name, giving you 100% ownership of your links.

✨ Why Shorterm?

  • Simple & Clean: Designed to be intuitive. No complex settings maze.
  • 100% Private: Your data stays on your server. No third-party tracking.
  • Performance Focused: Extremely lightweight code.

🟢 Free Features (Included)

  • Instant Shortening: Generate random short URLs (e.g., yoursite.com/x9z2) instantly.
  • Archive & Manage: View all your short links in a clean dashboard list.
  • SEO Friendly: Uses standard 301 redirects to pass link equity safely.
  • Search & Filter: Quickly find the link you are looking for.
  • Click Counter: Basic tracking to see total clicks per link.

🚀 Shorterm PRO (Unlock Full Power)

Upgrade to the Shorterm Pro version to get advanced marketing tools:

  • Custom Slugs: Create branded links like yoursite.com/black-friday or yoursite.com/social.
  • Advanced Analytics: Detailed reports including Referrers, Browsers, and Locations.
  • Excel Export: Download your click data for offline analysis.
  • Password Protection: Secure your exclusive links with a password.
  • Link Expiration: Set links to expire automatically after a specific date or number of clicks.
  • Premium Support: Get priority help directly from the developers.

View the Live Demo: Try Shorterm Pro

💡 Perfect For:

  • Bloggers: Clean up ugly long URLs in your posts.
  • Affiliates: Mask affiliate links to look professional and trustworthy.
  • Social Media: Share short, branded links in your bio.
  • eCommerce: Create short links for product promos and flash sales.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shorterm folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP, or upload the zip file through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Shorterm” menu in your sidebar and click “Add New” to create your first link!
sections.faq:
How does this plugin help with SEO?

Shorterm uses standard 301 redirects (Permanent Redirects), which tells search engines like Google to pass the ranking power to the destination URL. It creates clean, user-friendly URLs which are better for click-through rates.

Can I use it for Affiliate Links?

Absolutely! This is a great way to mask long, complicated affiliate tracking URLs and turn them into trustworthy links using your own domain.

Can I choose my own link name (slug)?

The Free version generates a unique random slug automatically. To create custom branded slugs (e.g., /my-offer), you need to upgrade to Shorterm Pro.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Yes, Shorterm follows WordPress coding standards and works seamlessly with all major themes and plugins, including Elementor, WooCommerce, and Yoast SEO.
